title: Settler Colonialism and Canadian Society
description: Examines the colonial foundations and contemporary state of Canadian society and politics. Topics include: settler colonialism, territorial expansion, staple economy, gendered politics of colonization, homogenization, land treaty, population movement, immigration, residential schools, racism and racialization, political ecology, globalization, and Indigenous resurgence.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCI 103, SOCI 200.
recommendations: Recommended prior to SOCI 235, SOCI 384, SOCI 436.
